The entire Application of the Supplier may not be considered confidential, but the Supplier may indicate that certain information provided in Application is confidential y marking the respective documents or information as “CONFIDENTIAL”. In any case, all confidential information of the Application must be provided by the potential winner / winner at the request of the Contracting Entity by completing Annex No. 7 of the SPC “Confidential Information” and providing documentation justifying the confidentiality of this information.
